description: Fork of exp475 (bs=16, TinyMHLut soft, 1.4962). SINGLE change: all 4 LUT modules -> MatmulMultiHeadLut (dense rational-gate matmul, full autograd, NO STE/argmax/softmax). Same anchors+soft-signs+bit-matrix+init (uniform +/-0.001, seed-matched) as exp475. Routing: c[k]=0.5*(1+ts/(T_sel+|ts|)) in [0,1] per row, then dense matmul c @ W[2^NAP, n_out]. Every weight gets gradient from every token (DENSE) -> directly attacks the per-parameter gradient-sparsity convergence bottleneck (project_lut_convergence_bottleneck). Costs K x n_out matmul/table (not matmul-free) - upper-bound experiment for how far dense gradients get us at bs=16. Compare convergence vs exp475 (same batch). OPTIMIZER: MatmulMHLut weights use the SAME AdamW group as the unembedder (lr=adam_lr=3e-4, betas=(0.9,0.95), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.1) — NOT the sparse-tuned LION/lut_lr=2e-4 (LION's edge was sparse-gradient-specific; dense matmul -> standard Adam). lut_optimizer/lut_lr in this config are unused.
